stage.note: NAVER Cloud is a wholly/majority-owned operating affiliate of publicly listed NAVER Corporation (originally spun out as Naver Business Platform / NBP in 2009, rebranded NAVER Cloud in 2021); it has not raised independent venture rounds, so 'subsidiary' is used instead of a venture stage.

note: NAVER Cloud (formerly Naver Business Platform / NBP, est. 2009, renamed NAVER Cloud in 2021) is the cloud-infrastructure and enterprise-software affiliate of NAVER Corporation, South Korea's largest internet company, publicly listed on the KOSPI (KRX: 035420). It is not independently funded/venture-backed and does not disclose standalone financials; figures above are for the parent NAVER Corporation (whole company) and its broader 'Enterprise' reporting segment, not NAVER Cloud alone.
